claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an electric foot pedal and power cord, indicating this is a motor-driven machine, not a hand-crank manual one.
No country-of-origin marking is visible anywhere on the machine in photo 0.
Seller now states it was tested yesterday, but no video or audio evidence has been provided to confirm this; a verbal claim alone does not change a photo-based assessment.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual included
claims.evidence: No accessories, bobbins, attachments, or manual booklet are visible in photo 0; none shown in response either.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: This is a history claim about maintenance that cannot be confirmed from a photo; the visible dust and grime do not support or deny it.

risks.risk: Motor may not run or may run poorly despite seller's reassurance.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine plugged in, pedal pressed, needle moving through several stitches.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (bobbins, extra needles, attachments) or manual, which affects usability and resale value.
risks.proof: A photo of the accessory box/case and the manual booklet laid out next to the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base machine only, no accessories

risks.risk: Internal rust or corrosion from age/storage, common in old machines, which can seize gears.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the internal bobbin area, feed dogs, and underside of the machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced as for cosmetic/display use only

risks.risk: Frayed or unsafe electrical cord/pedal wiring given visible age.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug end and cord insulation condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing rewiring before safe use

proof_requests: Video of the machine running (pedal pressed, needle stitching through fabric).
Photo of all included accessories and the manual laid out together.
Close-up of the plug and cord condition.
Photo of the underside/bobbin area for rust or corrosion.
Any visible nameplate or sticker showing country of manufacture.
response.reason: A verbal reassurance without new photographic or video evidence does not change the worst-case pricing; the item remains identified by its visible brand/model, but functional and completeness claims stay unverified until a demonstration clip or further photos are provided.
